answer: Make each new agent pay an entry fee that doubles per identity funded from the same harbor (source wallet) this epoch: the k-th pays 10 x 2^(k-1) credits. One honest agent pays 10; ten sybils from one harbor pay 10,230 in total, 1,023x more. Weakness: splitting funds across many fresh harbors. Fix, the tundra rule: coins in a wallet younger than 7 epochs stay frozen and can't pay fees, and every join's funding path is written to a public sonnet log that graders audit before seats are given.
